pipelineOrder: Freeze original catalogue per painter and scholar volume source; mark edition date and artist attribution grade
Count original oil paintings of religious subjects only and artwork versions separately; leave uncertain denominator explicitly UNKNOWN
Join all previously acquired originals plus source identities in waves 1–6 before any new download, exact object ID/title+museum match
Protect previously acquired 4–5 user-rated works from new sourcing, retain existing originals
Reject exactly user rated 0–2 originals across all target themes; a rejected work does not blacklist all of that painter's oeuvre
Rank unacquired originals by frequency across Rosary, major feasts, Mass/Bible Theatre and symbolic devotions, using real scene IDs.
Find permitted full resolution non-watermarked reproduction, verify pixels/hash/rights then stage for user's 0–5 rating
Only user-scored 5 can serve as repeat anchors; 3–4 for per-scene use when appropriate
No final production app merge without approved artwork and rights-certified reproduction
